author: rozaru
body:
@pgaudet 
I was looking at the children of neurotransmitter loading into synaptic vesicle.
If "aminergic neurotransmitter loading into synaptic vesicle” term covers neurotransmitters derived from amino acids dopamine, tyramine and octopamine should be its children.

Is it necessary to have aminergic neurotransmitter loading into synaptic vesicle as a grouping term?

```
neurotransmitter loading into synaptic vesicle
|__aminergic neurotransmitter loading into synaptic vesicle
|__dopamine loading into synaptic vesicle
|__tyramine loading into synaptic vesicle
|__octopamine loading into synaptic vesiclcle
```
